clare: Heads-up: runtime changed defaults (batching -> "aggressive", introduced "q8-dynmix"). Need a 2-line relnote + migration steps and update SDK snippets (py & js). tagging @rachel and @samir.
rachel: I can draft the relnote. Quick ask: what should be the user-facing bullets? Keep it short.
samir: User bullets: 1) default `batching.policy` = "aggressive" (better throughput for long sequences) 2) new quant profile `q8-dynmix` available on x86-gpu 3) q4_0/q4_1 still work but deprecated. Also add opt-out instructions.
clare: Known issue: short-sequence latency can regress ~10-20ms in low-concurrency cases. Show how to opt out per-call and globally.
rachel: Draft relnote: "Serving defaults updated: batching now 'aggressive' to boost long-sequence throughput. New quant profile `q8-dynmix` available; legacy q4_* profiles deprecated. Known issue: sub-100-token latency may increase in some setups; see migration notes to opt out."
rachel: Draft Python snippet for opt-out:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-1-small", prompt=prompt, config={"batching": {"policy": "none"}, "quant_profile": "q4_1"})
```
clare: Add migration steps: Console -> Settings -> Global overrides, and CLI for private deploys: `redwoodctl set global-config --batching.policy=none --quant_profile=q4_1`.
